excludedCandidates.reason: OPTIMISE II randomized 2498 older adults undergoing elective major gastrointestinal surgery. Cardiac-output-guided fluid plus low-dose inotrope did not reduce 30-day postoperative infection and increased 24-hour acute cardiac events, but the perioperative elective-surgery question is not sufficiently ED-focused for this selective backfill.
